arxiv-2101-08662.title: Lattice and Electronic properties of VO 2 with the SCAN(+ U U ) approach
arxiv-2101-08662.creator: Sooran Kim
arxiv-2101-08662.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sooran Kim. Appropriate consideration of the electron correlation is essential to reproduce the intriguing metal-insulator transition accompanying the Peierls-type structural transition in VO 2 . In the density functional theory-based approach, this depends on the choice of the exchange-correlation functional. Here, using a newly developed strongly constrained and appropriately norm (SCAN) functional, we investigate the lattice and electronic properties of the metallic rutile phase of VO 2 ( R R -VO 2 ) from the first-principles calculations.

arxiv-2205-15201.title: Controller Design and Experimental Evaluation of a Motorized Assistance for a Patient Transfer Floor Lift
arxiv-2205-15201.creator: Donatien Callon, Ian Lalonde, Mathieu Nadeau and Alexandre Girard
arxiv-2205-15201.description: Abstract Patient transfer is a challenging, critical task because it exposes caregivers to injury risks. Available transfer devices, like floor lifts, lead to improvements but are far from perfect. They do not eliminate the caregivers’ risk of musculoskeletal disorders, and they can be burdensome to use due to their poor maneuverability.

arxiv-2308-11098.title: On the Interpretability of Quantum Neural Networks
arxiv-2308-11098.creator: Lirandë Pira, Chris Ferrie
arxiv-2308-11098.description: Abstract Interpretability of artificial intelligence (AI) methods, particularly deep neural networks, is of great interest. This heightened focus stems from the widespread use of AI-backed systems. These systems, often relying on intricate neural architectures, can exhibit behavior that is challenging to explain and comprehend. The interpretability of such models is a crucial component of building trusted systems.

arxiv-2309-01788.title: Hierarchical Grammar-Induced Geometry for Data-Efficient Molecular Property Prediction
arxiv-2309-01788.creator: Minghao Guo, Veronika Thost, Samuel W Song, Adithya Balachandran, Payel Das, Jie Chen, Wojciech Matusik
arxiv-2309-01788.description: Abstract The prediction of molecular properties is a crucial task in the field of material and drug discovery. The potential benefits of using deep learning techniques are reflected in the wealth of recent literature. Still, these techniques are faced with a common challenge in practice: Labeled data are limited by the cost of manual extraction from literature and laborious experimentation.

arxiv-2405-16541.title: Variance-Reducing Couplings for Random Features
arxiv-2405-16541.creator: Isaac Reid, Stratis Markou, Krzysztof Choromanski, Richard E. Turner, Adrian Weller
arxiv-2405-16541.description: Abstract Random features (RFs) are a popular technique to scale up kernel methods in machine learning, replacing exact kernel evaluations with stochastic Monte Carlo estimates. They underpin models as diverse as efficient transformers (by approximating attention) to sparse spectrum Gaussian processes (by approximating the covariance function).

arxiv-2509-24736.title: Bundle Network: a Machine Learning-Based Bundle Method
arxiv-2509-24736.creator: Francesca Demelas, Antonio Frangioni, Mathieu Lacroix, Joseph Le Roux, Emiliano Traversi, Roberto Wolfler Calvo
arxiv-2509-24736.description: Abstract This paper presents Bundle Network , a learning-based algorithm inspired by the Bundle Method for convex non-smooth minimization problems. Unlike classical approaches that rely on heuristic tuning of a regularization parameter, our method automatically learns to adjust it from data.

arxiv-2512-24813.title: Learning Temporally Consistent Turbulence Between Sparse Snapshots via Diffusion Models
arxiv-2512-24813.creator: M. Sardar, M. J. Zimoń, S. Draycott, A. Revell, A. Skillen
arxiv-2512-24813.description: Abstract 1 Abstract We investigate the statistical accuracy of temporally interpolated spatiotemporal flow sequences between sparse, decorrelated snapshots of turbulent flow fields using conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs). The developed method is presented as a proof-of-concept generative surrogate for reconstructing coherent turbulent dynamics between sparse snapshots, demonstrated on a 2D Kolmogorov Flow, and a 3D Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability (KHI).

pmc-11394465.title: The Regulatory Role of Myomaker in the Muscle Growth of the Chinese Perch (Siniperca chuatsi)
pmc-11394465.creator: Wei Zeng, Yangyang Meng, Lingtao Nie, Congyi Cheng, Zexia Gao, Lusha Liu, Xin Zhu, Wuying Chu, Michael Lindinger
pmc-11394465.description: Simple SummaryMyomaker has been reported to play an important role in regulating myoblast fusion. However, the role of Myomaker gene in skeletal muscle growth in economic fish during post-hatching stage is unclear. This study showed that the growth of Chinese perch was significantly decreased when Myomaker was inhibited by Myomaker-siRNA.

pmc-12613110.creator: Eric Umehara, Dayana A. S Ferreira, Mariana B. Abiuzi, Myron Christodoulides, Ravi Kant, Andre G. Tempone, João Henrique G. Lago
pmc-12613110.description: The hexane extract of Drimys brasiliensis (Winteraceae) branches displayed activity against trypomastigote forms of Trypanosoma cruzi and was subjected to a bioactivity-guided fractionation procedures to afford four bisabolenerel-(3S,7R)-3-hydroxy-bisabola-1­(6),10-dien-2-one (1), rel-(2S,3S,7R)-bisabola-1­(6),10-diene-2,3-diol (2), rel-(3S,6R,7R)-3,6-epidioxy-1,10-bisaboladiene (3), and α-curcumene (4)as well as two drimanepolygodial (5), and 9-deoxymuzigadial (6)type sesquiterpenes. This is the first report of compounds 1 and 2 as natural products.

pmc-12749727.title: A hierarchy of time constants and reliable signal propagation in the marmoset cerebral cortex
pmc-12749727.creator: Guanchun Li, Songting Li, Xiao-Jing Wang
pmc-12749727.description: A hierarchy of timescales in the cerebral cortex is functionally desirable for rapid information processing in sensory areas and slow time integration in association areas. Here, through an analysis of electrocorticography (ECoG) data, we identified a timescale hierarchy in the neocortex of marmoset, a primate species commonly used in neuroscience.

pmc-13440214.title: Phase‐Dependent Oxygen Defect Energetics in Epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN Films
pmc-13440214.creator: Prachi Garg, Kedarsh Kaushik, Danqing Wang, Naomi Pieczulewski, Anand Ithepalli, John Wright, Debdeep Jena, David A Muller, Hong X Tang, Cyrus Dreyer, Baishakhi Mazumder
pmc-13440214.description: Epitaxial all‐nitride Josephson junctions are promising components for high coherence superconducting qubits, yet nanoscale defects often limit their performance. The key to mitigating these defects lies in understanding the atomic‐scale relationship between polymorph selection, defect chemistry, and device performance. Here, we investigate structural and chemical defects in epitaxially grown 𝛿‐NbN/AlN/𝛿‐NbN, 𝛾‐Nb4N3/AlN/𝛾‐Nb4N3, β‐Nb2N/AlN/β‐Nb2N heterostructures on c‐plane sapphire using molecular beam epitaxy.

pmc-13579752.title: Cellular crosstalk of fibroblast–myofibroblast transition in intestinal homeostasis and disease
pmc-13579752.creator: Haodong Yuan, Lin Zhao, Peiqi Xu, Yu Sun, Kai Yin, Shengjun Wang
pmc-13579752.description: Fibroblasts are central components of the intestinal microenvironment and can acquire a myofibroblast phenotype through fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition (FMT), a process linked to increased tissue mechanosensitivity and active extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. In this way, FMT participates in normal intestinal homeostasis and repair, but it can also contribute to fibrosis and tumor-associated stromal remodeling when sustained.

pmc-13662498.title: Interhospital Transfer Patients With Necrotizing Soft Tissue Infections: An Evaluation of the Role for Pretransport Operation
pmc-13662498.creator: Hans V Strobl, Diane N Haddad, Renee Bicaba, Renee I Tristano, Phillip M Dowzicky, Abid D Khan, Timothy P Plackett, Justin S Hatchimonji
pmc-13662498.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEarly debridement is the cornerstone of treatment for necrotizing soft tissue infections (NSTI), but patients are frequently transferred for management. We described practice patterns, hypothesizing that pre‐transfer NSTI debridement is associated with improved outcomes.MethodsWe analyzed data from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP) State Inpatient Databases (SID) and State Emergency Department Databases (SEDD) for Massachusetts, Wisconsin, and Colorado in 2022. NSTI patients and the subset undergoing operation before transfer (PRE) were identified. The primary outcome was mortality.

uslaw-usc-t36-s40509.title: 36 U.S.C. § 40509 — Service of process
uslaw-usc-t36-s40509.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s40509.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 405 (Congressional Medal Of Honor Society Of The United States Of America). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation shall have a designated agent in the District of Columbia to receive service of process for the corporation. Notice to or service on the agent, or mailed.
